'''Tund''' was a [[Star/Legends|star]] located in the [[Tund system/Legends|Tund system]] of the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was orbited by a single [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
